message.content: {"bear": [{"cites": ["S3.u04", "S4.u04"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "EBITDA margin contracted by 170 basis points to 11.2% in Q1 FY27, driven by a sharp rise in copper prices."}, {"cites": ["S5.u11", "S5.u12"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Receivable days increased from 78 to 96 over the last year, primarily due to slower payments from two large state utility customers."}, {"cites": ["S8.u01"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "The company received a GST demand order for ₹46.3 crore relating to input tax credits claimed for FY2020-21 and FY2021-22."}], "bull": [{"cites": ["S3.u02"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Revenue from operations grew 18.0% year-over-year to ₹1,248 crore in Q1 FY27."}, {"cites": ["S3.u06"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "The order book stood at ₹3,900 crore as of 30 June 2026, up from ₹3,150 crore a year ago."}, {"cites": ["S3.u08", "S5.u02"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "Management states the new Bharuch plant is on track to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27, adding about 30% to cable capacity."}, {"cites": ["S3.u07"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Exports contributed 21% of revenue in Q1 FY27, up from 16% in the same period last year."}], "open_questions": [{"cites": ["S3.u02", "S4.u02"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "The company's press release reports Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹1,248 crore, while a news article reports ₹1,428 crore. Which figure is accurate?"}, {"cites": ["S8.u02", "S8.u03"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "Management intends to appeal the GST demand and expects no material impact, but what is the likelihood of a successful appeal?"}, {"cites": ["S5.u07", "S5.u10"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "Management expects to pass on higher copper costs over the next two quarters, but how effective will this be given the lag in price-variation clauses?"}], "snapshot": [{"cites": ["S3.u01"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors."}, {"cites": ["S3.u02", "S3.u05"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "In Q1 FY27, the company reported revenue of ₹1,248 crore and profit after tax of ₹82 crore."}, {"cites": ["S2.u01", "S2.u02"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "As of June 2026, promoters held 58.2% of the company, with 4.1% of that holding pledged."}]}
